title: Nonrandom DNA Segregation Detection under Replication Stress
protocol: Add CldU to the culture media at a final concentration of 1 μM for two consecutive weeks.
Passage cells every 72 hours during the treatment period.
Seed 1–2 × 10^5 cells on a 20 mm poly-lysine-coated glass coverslip in a 12 well plate for immunofluorescence verification.
Culture cells in the absence of CldU for one cell cycle (around 24 h).
Treat cells with DNA polymerase inhibitor aphidicolin at 0.3 μM and CDK1 inhibitor RO3306 at 9 μM to induce replication stress and G2/M arrest.
Replate cells at 30-50% confluence in CldU-free media for one cell cycle (about 24 h).
Add thymidine directly to the culture media at a final concentration of 2 mM for 18 hours to synchronize cells in S phase.
Wash the cells with prewarmed PBS for three times within 5 minutes.
Reseed the cells into a new 10 cm dish at 50% confluence in culture media supplemented with 9 μM RO3306 and 0.3 μM aphidicolin.
Incubate the cells for 16 hours to allow them to reach late S phase to G2/M boundary.
Wash the cells with prewarmed PBS for three times within 5 minutes.
Add 6 mL of prewarmed culture media to the plate.
Place the culture plate back into a 37°C incubator for another 30 minutes to release the cells into mitosis.
Remove 3 mL of culture media from the culture dish.
Gently tap the side of the plate to shake off loosely attached mitotic cells.
Rotate the plate between taps for even removal.
Rinse the plate with the remaining 3 mL of media.
Collect the mitotic cells in a 15 mL tube at 25°C–37°C.
Repeat the shake-off process 1–3 times, aspirating and adding fresh 3 mL media each time.
Gently aspirate any liquid adhering to the lid or edge of the plate for better recovery.
Verify under the microscope that few mitotic cells remain on the culture plate.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the collected mitotic cells in 3 mL of fresh media.
Seed the cells into a 12 well culture plate with appropriate number of coverslips.
Incubate the seeded cells at 37°C for at least 140 minutes to allow progression into G1 phase.
Wash cells with PBS once.
Fix cells with ice-cold 70% ethanol at -20°C for at least 2 h.
Immunostain the fixed cells.
Incubate cells with 2 N HCl containing 0.5% Triton X-100 (500 μL each well) at 4°C for 1 h.
Wash cells twice with 0.5% Triton X-100/0.5% BSA in PBS.
Wash cells once with 0.5% Triton X-100/0.1% BSA in PBS.
Block cells using 5% BSA/0.5% Triton X-100 in PBS at 4°C for 1 hour.
Prepare 3% BSA as antibody dilution buffer by adding 300 mg BSA to 10 ml PBS and mixing well.
Incubate cells with anti-BrdU BU1/75 (1:1000 dilution in 3% BSA) at 4°C for at least 8 hours.
Wash cells three times with PBS.
Incubate cells with anti-rat Alexa Fluor 594 (1:2000 dilution in 3% BSA) for 1 hour at room temperature, protected from light.
Wash cells three times to reduce nonspecific binding.
Wash cells once with PBS.
Incubate cells with 1 μg/mL DAPI (400 μL each well) at 4°C for 10 minutes, protected from light.
Pipette 20–30 μl of Fluoromount-G mounting media on each clean glass slide.
Remove coverslips carefully using a syringe with curved needle and tweezers.
Mount the coverslips with cells facing down onto the glass slides.
Seal the coverslips with nail polish.
Use DAPI channel (Ex 359 nm) to locate suspicious daughter cells whose nuclei are close to each other.
Validate the suspicious daughter cells as bona fide using DIC channel.
Capture images with DAPI channel (Ex 359 nm).
Capture images with TRITC channel (Ex 550 nm).
Convert a stored image of the TRITC channel to 8-bit grayscale.
Adjust the threshold on the image using the slider.
Set measurement parameters including Integrated density (IntDen) and shape descriptors.
Select one daughter cell using area selection tools.
Obtain IntDen value for the selected daughter cell by clicking measure.
Calculate relative fluorescence as log2 (IntDen of one daughter cell / IntDen of another daughter cell).
Define daughter cells with a relative fluorescence above 8 as NDS.
